params.1273: Cast Wind Strike at a dummy or a hostile target.
params.1274: To cast Wind Strike, you will need one air and one mind rune (Varrock's magic shop gives free samples).
params.1275: Open your Magic Spellbook and click on the Wind Strike icon to set it as your attack.
params.1276: Choose 'Attack' on a suitable target to cast the spell at it.
params.1277: You can keep using the spell as your attack as long as you have runes.
params.1278: Click on the spell in the interface again to stop using it.
params.2225: Wind Strike is your first attack spell; as you gain levels in Magic you can unlock more powerful variants.
